Game Overview

In Hex Planet Idle, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a hypnotic journey as a stickman adventurer in Hex Planet Idle. Delve into an expansive universe, utilizing white zones for strategic resource gathering. Enjoy automated collection and unlock new realms, uncovering enigmatic elements as you progress through this captivating RPG survival experience.
